descriptionHtml:
Stop slipping on slippery surfaces

Wet stairs, bathtubs and boat decks easily become slippery and dangerous. One misstep is all it takes for things to go badly.

Stick it on – get grip right away

The self-adhesive anti-slip tape gives a rough, secure grip on slippery surfaces. You just cut it to the right length and press it on – it stays put even when wet.

Features

  • Self-adhesive – easy to put up
  • Rough grip even on wet surfaces
  • 6 meters – enough for many steps
  • For stairs, bathtubs, boat decks and ramps
  • Easy to cut to the right length

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
